name: sim_join_keeps_cfg_plans
description: The sim harness's join_from gives a client loaded from a checkpoint what cfg gives every client at start and no checkpoint holds: the stack lists ("stacks"), the plans ("plans", "never_patch") its caretakers play and "play_on". A Tide Race of two caretakers, the Lamplighter handed the list [4] and the Lookout none, played on past the decision: a client joined at tick 3 stacks as client 1 does and plays the decided race on with it, every hash the same (review of M8's rules: joined clients took the plans' own lists, [2, 3] and [5], and stopped at the decision).

steps.assert: joined.stacks['lamplighter'] == PackedInt32Array([4]) and joined.stacks['lookout'] == PackedInt32Array() and joined.play_on
steps.msg: the joined client plays cfg's lists, played on

steps.assert: ran[0] == [4] and ran[1] == [] and ran[2] != '' and ran[3] > 0 and ran[4] > ran[3]
steps.msg: client 1 stacked wave 4 on the Lamplighter's hollow and none on the Lookout's, and played the decided race on

steps.assert: ran[5] == ran[4] and scene.hashes_agree() and scene.hash_at(ran[4] / 60 * 60, 2) != ''
steps.msg: the joined client played every tick with it, every hash the same to the end
